query: INSERT INTO shop_offer_overrides (item_type_id, enabled, pang, note, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, now()) ON CONFLICT (item_type_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, pang = EXCLUDED.pang, note = EXCLUDED.note, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = now()
